title: Shady Sands endings
description: Mutually exclusive futures for Shady Sands; later continuity may select one branch without making all branches concurrent.

title: Junktown endings
description: Political and invasion outcomes determined by the local conflict and Unity's wider advance.

title: Necropolis endings
description: Water restoration, dehydration, and mutant invasion are distinct branches.

title: Khans endings
description: The gang may be destroyed, regroup, or fall to the mutant advance.

title: The Hub endings
description: Fallout supplies selected state-dependent slides rather than an exhaustive result for every Hub configuration.

title: Followers endings
description: Survival and later influence are opposed to destruction during the mutant advance.

title: Brotherhood endings
description: The cautious-aid and Steel Plague endings are contradictory alternatives, not simultaneous faction traits.

title: Vault 13 failure states
description: Water exhaustion and Unity discovery are failure branches outside the successful route.

title: The Overseer's final scene
description: Exile occurs on the successful route; the Overseer's death remains an optional player action.

title: Master confrontation resolutions
description: The Master can be defeated by more than one route; persuasion and self-destruction are conditional rather than universal events.
